ResultCopyButton (native-safe stand-in for CopyButton, web L2): a Pressable (accessibilityRole=button, accessibilityLabel=label, testID result-panel-copy) that mirrors CopyButton's Copy->Copied->Copy(2s) behaviour: handlePress fires a best-effort writeTextToClipboard(text) then setCopied(true) and a setTimeout(()=>setCopied(false), 2000) (COPIED_RESET_MS), with a useEffect cleanup clearing the timer on unmount. Labels 'Copy'/'Copied' keep CopyButton's i18n keys common.copyButton.copy/.copied (defaults inlined; ResultPanel itself uses no i18n in the web source). The lucide Copy/CheckCircle icons -> decorative AppText glyphs (\u29C9 idle, \u2713 copied; \u2713 tinted success) — the established native glyph stand-in approach. writeTextToClipboard guards globalThis.navigator?.clipboard?.writeText: it actually copies on the web/react-native-web target and is a documented no-op on a bare native device (no @react-native-clipboard/clipboard dependency installed); the press feedback toggle is preserved on all targets so the affordance stays meaningful (explicit native-safe degraded state).
